findings.title: A clear announcement title
findings.explanation: The final announcement needs a title so readers can identify its purpose.
findings.suggestion: Add a specific title that identifies the change.

findings.title: Target audience identified
findings.explanation: Readers need to know whether this announcement applies to them.
findings.suggestion: Name the affected students, staff, visitors, or service users.

findings.title: A concrete next step
findings.explanation: This scenario requires an explicit action in the final announcement.
findings.suggestion: Tell readers exactly what to do next, even if no action is needed.

findings.title: An exact effective time
findings.explanation: A valid date and time are required. Relative phrases such as “tomorrow” are ambiguous.
findings.suggestion: Set the exact date and time this change takes effect.

findings.title: Time zone provided
findings.explanation: A clock time without a time zone can be interpreted differently by readers.
findings.suggestion: Specify the local time zone and UTC offset, for example London (UTC+00:00).

findings.title: A reachable verification source
findings.explanation: Readers need a contact route or an update source. A name alone is insufficient.
findings.suggestion: Include an email address, phone number, or full https:// update URL.

findings.title: Time range is consistent
findings.explanation: If an end time is provided, it must be valid and later than the start, in the stated time zone.
findings.suggestion: Use a valid end date and time later than the start, or leave the end blank if unknown.

findings.title: Additional prose needs human review
findings.explanation: The rules check structured facts. They cannot detect contradictions, misleading claims, or unclear language in additional context.
findings.suggestion: Review the context against every structured fact in the final preview, or remove redundant context.

findings.title: Structured facts included in final text
findings.explanation: The final preview is regenerated from the checked fields on every edit. Free-text context is separately marked for review.
findings.suggestion: Copy or download the generated final announcement, then obtain the appropriate human approval.

findings.title: Affected entrance identified
findings.explanation: A closure must identify the entrance or location that is unavailable.
findings.suggestion: Name the closed entrance and campus or building.

findings.title: An alternative entrance
findings.explanation: People need an explicit alternative route while the entrance is closed.
findings.suggestion: Add the alternative entrance and directions to reach it.

findings.title: Accessible route described
findings.explanation: An alternative entrance is not automatically accessible. Readers may need step-free route information.
findings.suggestion: Describe the step-free route, or give a contact for access assistance. Verify it on site.

findings.title: Closure end time provided
findings.explanation: An end time helps readers plan their return. If it is unknown, the action should explain where to get updates.
findings.suggestion: Add the expected reopening date and time when confirmed.
